brief.title: Scrub credentials, personal addresses, and home paths from a local session JSONL
brief.plain_summary: Run session_distiller redact on a local coding-session JSONL transcript and record redaction counters plus the sanitized event stream digest.
brief.outcome: A sanitized trace summary with SHA-256 digest and redaction counts.

required: Run python3 -m session_distiller redact on the local JSONL file inside the workspace.
